'''Pol Revver''' was an individual who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] once tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with delivering an item to Revver, circa [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].
